parts.text: In this experiment, you will determine the resistance of a resistor. The circuit has been set up for you. Refer to Fig. 2.1. Fig. 2.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Attach the crocodile clip to a length l = 100.0 cm of the resistance wire. Close the switch. Measure the potential difference (p.d.) V 0 across the resistor for l = 100.0 cm. V 0 = ...................................................... V [1] Open the switch.

ms.label: 2(a)
ms.text: suitable value of V0 (1.5 V to 3.5 V) to at least 1 dp.

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Adjust the position of the crocodile clip on the resistance wire to a length l = 20.0 cm. Close the switch. Measure and record, in Table 2.1, the value of the current I in the circuit. Measure and record, in Table 2.1, values of the current I for l = 30.0 cm, l = 40.0 cm, l = 50.0 cm and l = 60.0 cm. Open the switch. Table 2.1 l / cm I / A 20.0 30.0 40.0 50.0 60.0 [2]

ms.label: 2(b)
ms.text:
5 values of I
all ascending and to 2 decimal places at least

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Plot a graph of l / cm (y-axis) against I / A (x-axis). Draw a best-fit straight line. You do not need to start the axes at the origin (0,0). [4]

ms.label: 2(c)
ms.text:
graph:
•
axes labelled with quantity and unit
•
appropriate scales (plots occupying at least ½ grid)
•
plots all correct to ½ small square and precise plots
•
well-judged line and thin line

parts.label: i
parts.text: (d) (i) Determine the gradient G of the graph. Show clearly on the graph how you obtained the necessary information. G = ......................................................... [1]

ms.label: 2(d)(i)
ms.text:
G present
and triangle method seen on graph

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate the resistance R of the resistor. Use your value of V 0 from (a) and the equation R = G × V 0 100k where k = 1.0 A R = ...................................................... Ω [1]

ms.label: 2(e)
ms.text:
valid practical source of inaccuracy, e.g:
uncertain connection point on crocodile clip /
resistance wire irregular / curved / not uniform / differing thickness along wire

ms.label: 2(f)
ms.text:
suitable improvement e.g:
reduce e.m.f. of power supply /
thinner resistance wire /
use of additional series / protective resistor to reduce current
